description: Participant-authored intent cases. Every text is taken from the supplied
texts written here to probe the boundaries of the documented rule: an
incidental negative inside a real erasure request, a refusal phrased with
'not asking', a retention instruction that also names the act of removal, and
a non-English access request. 'expected' is the authorisation decision the
task definition requires, not merely what the current implementation returns.

cases.text: Please delete my account and confirm when it is done.
I changed the email on this account before deleting it. Please check that nothing tied to the old address was left behind, even in systems that do not display the email.
cases.why: The negative clause is about display, not about deletion (case_12).

cases.text: I found an old report saying my account still existed. Please check the latest state and confirm that the profile is gone and that remaining records cannot identify me.
cases.why: An erasure follow-up may contain no deletion verb at all (case_26).

cases.text: Please stop the promotional emails. I still need the account and my order history, so I am not asking for deletion.
cases.why: Marketing opt-out with an explicit refusal of deletion (case_534).

cases.text: I can't access my profile and need help resetting the login. Do not close the account.
cases.why: Access request guarded by a narrow negation of closure (case_536).

cases.text: I'd like to download my account information in a portable format. Please keep the account as it is.
cases.why: Portability request with a retention instruction (case_535).

cases.text: My surname is misspelled on the account. Can you correct it without removing any of my records?
cases.why: Correction request; 'removing' appears only inside a prohibition (case_537).

cases.text: I need a copy of last year's invoices for my records. Please leave my profile and purchase history in place.
cases.why: Copy request with an explicit retention instruction (case_540).

cases.text: Je demande la suppression définitive du compte associé à cette adresse e-mail.
Solicito a exclusão permanente da conta associada a este e-mail.
このメールアドレスに紐づくアカウントを完全に削除してください。
Quiero recibir una copia de los datos que tienen sobre mí. No quiero que borren nada.
cases.why: Spanish access request with a refusal to delete.

cases.text: Bitte löschen Sie mein Konto und alle zugehörigen Daten dauerhaft.
Delete the data you hold about me, but keep invoices the law requires you to keep.
cases.why: Erasure request that itself accepts a legal-hold exception.
